item.title: Issue #145: OpenAI Clarifies Annualized Revenue at $50 Billion, Pushing IPO to 2027
item.description: OpenAI has informed investors that its true annualized revenue run rate is $50 billion—some $20 billion lower than previous figures circulated by investors attempting to match Anthropic's reporting methodology. The discrepancy stems from differing accounting treatments of partner cloud sales, while macroeconomic pressure and safety concerns have delayed OpenAI's anticipated IPO to early 2027.

item.title: Issue #144: Humanize Orchestrates Multi-Agent Coding via Deterministic Gates and Cross-Vendor Review
item.description: Humanize is a multi-agent orchestration workflow that replaces probabilistic model routing with 72 deterministic hooks to enforce mechanical boundaries between planning, implementation, and review. By alternating builder and reviewer samples across different model vendors, defects only survive if both models fail to catch them.

item.title: Issue #142: Auxiliary-Loss-Free Balancing in Mixture-of-Experts
item.description: DeepSeek-V3 introduces dynamic bias adjustment to prevent expert collapse without gradient contamination.
